ask: mkae a sign up for the moving stuff plz
sentence: A sign-up sheet for moving day where each person can join or leave limited-capacity jobs like loading, driving, packing and unloading, with a count of filled spots.
use_when: A group needs helpers for a move and wants each job to have a set number of people
Someone wants a shared sign-up list for tasks with limited spots
People should be able to pick or drop a job themselves and see who else is on it
dont_use_when: The group needs to vote on one choice, such as a date or place
Tasks need to be assigned to people by one organizer
The list needs to track expenses or split costs
